name: budget50
_about: Fits 50 EUR for 1,000 messages even if every message has a plan of 30 actions. Google models only. gemini-3.1-flash-lite for almost everything (it does not think, so it costs little), gemini-3.5-flash-lite for the planner (the one step that needs reasoning: a Lite model, rated ok). Untested as a combination. It replaces gemini-2.5-flash for the planner and gemini-2.5-flash-lite for three steps, which Google no longer gives to new keys.
